units.source_text: 在三个半小时里，大竹七段不仅思考了黑101，

en.t: During those three and a half hours, Otake 7-dan not only thought about Black 101,

units.source_text: 而且努力把心思拉回到已离开三个月的围棋上来，

en.t: but also struggled to bring his mind back to the game of Go, from which he had been away for three months,

units.source_text: 似乎是想尽量掌握全局的形势和今后的下法。

en.t: as if trying to grasp as fully as possible the overall position and the moves to come.
